title: Heat and electricity
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. An informative illustrated engineering notebook plate. At left a small period power-station building in a snow-trench cutaway; at upper right draw heating pipes entering an ordinary timber room; lower right draw an ordinary generator feeding simple lights. Two separate short ink leaders show different output concepts, not an efficiency Sankey and not a reactor design. Exact text only: PM-2A; Approx. 10 MW thermal; Approx. 1.5 MW electric; Heat and electricity are different quantities. Use a large detailed machinery/environment drawing rather than three text rows; do not depict fuel geometry or technical internals. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
